items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Mary Robinson played every duck there was on that sheet. Not a duck missing.

ctx.x: Wealthy people. New Orleans is loaded with a massive wealth. You know that, don't you? The Sugar Kings, the Cotton Kings, all that Dean Witter and company down there. John had to quit playing with his body on his arm, so he's walking around the floor, you see, and something once around there. But he's a celebrity like anybody else. That was John Robichaux. Mary Robinson played every duck there was on that sheet. Not a duck missing. Wendell on his violin, equally as good. And he could play some violin too. A man…
I said, but look at what we're good now. I said, are we going to play that?
